title: Parents: a concert-singer father and pianist mother
summary: Williams, going on 90, says his father was a concert singer and his mother a fine pianist; they sang before royalty in London.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I tell it to start from when you come down here. Is that what you want? Well, I'd like to know how old he is, too. Well, tell them how old you are. You all right? I'm going on 90. I'm going on 90. I'm going on 90. I'm going on 90. That's right. Listen, my mother and father, my father was a concert singer.
He sang with Mary Gardner and other singers. He sang also with a Philadelphia Philharmonic orchestra. My mother was a fine pianist. And they sang before the King and Queens in Crystal Palace, London.
